title: Consumer lever inventory
description: agents/settings/security-ops.yml — the levers a deployed product can throw to contain a vulnerability, read by `agent-config audit:security` (contain lens) and the advisory loop. Validated by src/scripts/_lib/security_ops.ts::validateSecurityOps, which also enforces what this draft cannot express: an L4 lever is never released through the control surface it takes offline, no lever stops the control surface, and under control_surface: same-app no L3 or http-stopping lever is released through the control surface. Design: src/skills/security-audit/references/control-section.md; decision: ADR-304.

operator_path.description: The primary operator path. A URL secret is break-glass at most.

break_glass.description: A path that works without the web UI.

control_surface.description: Default separate (the blueprint). same-app: a lever that stops the app's HTTP or is L3 cannot be released through the control surface.

automation.description: Default off. propose: an advisory may raise a proposal to throw the mapped lever, which an operator confirms — never an unattended throw (ADR-304). Needs at least one lever with packages.

fail_mode.description: What the product does when the lever store cannot be read.

packages.description: Packages whose advisories this lever contains.
